svg.title: Hermes Agent Gemini Voice: talk to your Hermes Agent from an Android phone with Gemini Live on Gemini 4 Argon
svg.desc: A holographic AI assistant rises from an Android phone lock screen with a live voice panel and touches the Hermes Agent robot through a living voice waveform. Cards show what the agent does with voice tasks: a morning briefing at 08:00, a voice task answered in a document, a new row in an expenses sheet, and the key features: hands-free from the lock screen, Calendar, Docs and Sheets, owner-only tasks, replies read aloud.
